items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Well, they have another drummer over there from here. Old fellow in San Antonio.

ctx.x: No, I think it was Jimmy Noon, not Kepard, Jimmy Noon. Oh, Jimmy Noon? Jimmy Noon, that's who it was. Who was that on base, Bill? Bill Johnson, we've been trying to find him. He's over probably in San Antonio now. He's about 90 years old, he would be. He was 75 when I saw him. He's still living? He was two years ago. Did you find out from Don Albert? I asked him, he didn't know him. He said he's never seen him over there.
Well, they have another drummer over there from here. Old fellow in San Antonio.
Did you see Don Albert, I guess?
